title: The Bone Key
text: A key carved from a finger bone hangs on a cord over a barrow's door, turning slowly though there is no wind. The knuckle still has a ring on it. The lock beneath it is shaped like a mouth.

options.label: Put the bone key in the mouth.

outcomes.text: The mouth swallows it, and the door opens on a quiet tomb and its treasure.
The door opens on a tomb that was not quiet at all.

options.label: The wisest works out whose finger it was.

outcomes.text: The barrow's maker. He did not want it opened, and he wrote down why.
It sways after you as you go, though there is no wind, like a finger beckoning.
